enum.name: IVAQ_MINI_RX_STATUS
enum.description: These values define the status of the receiver.

enum.name: IVAQ_MINI_CARD_STATE
enum.description: Physical microSD card presence; presence does not imply a mounted, writable filesystem.

enum.name: IVAQ_MINI_SIGNAL_SAT
enum.description: These values define the boolean states.

enum.name: IVAQ_MINI_SIGNAL_DET
enum.description: These values define the boolean states.

enum.name: IVAQ_MINI_RX_RESET
enum.description: These values define the boolean states.

enum.name: IVAQ_MINI_RX_UPDATE
enum.description: These values define the firmware update command states.

entry.name: IVAQ_MINI_UPDATE_TRUE
entry.description: Firmware update requested - enter bootloader mode

enum.name: IVAQ_MINI_DETECTION_MASK
enum.description: Antennas with a detection in the reported event; X and Y are independent bits.

enum.name: IVAQ_MINI_SET_CAPTURE
enum.description: Requested capture action. Zero leaves capture unchanged, including during reset/update commands.

entry.name: IVAQ_MINI_SET_CAPTURE_START_SD
entry.description: Start a capture and save to microSD.

entry.name: IVAQ_MINI_SET_CAPTURE_START_HOST
entry.description: Start a capture and transfer to the host without writing microSD; independent of USB/UART transport.

entry.name: IVAQ_MINI_SET_CAPTURE_STOP
entry.description: Request cancellation of the active acquisition or transfer.

enum.name: IVAQ_MINI_CAPTURE_STATE
enum.description: Reported acquisition/transfer state; these values are not commands.

enum.name: IVAQ_MINI_TIME_REFERENCE
enum.description: Clock reference shared by all timestamps in this message.

entry.name: IVAQ_MINI_TIME_BOOT
entry.description: Milliseconds since receiver boot; host synchronization not established.

entry.name: IVAQ_MINI_TIME_UNIX
entry.description: Milliseconds since UNIX epoch using host-synchronized time.

message.name: SYSTEM_TIME
message.description: The system time is the time of the master clock, typically the computer clock of the main onboard computer.
message.field: Timestamp (UNIX epoch time).
Timestamp (time since system boot).

message.name: IVAQ_RX_MINI_PARAMS
message.description: Board-level status of the single-PCB, two-antenna IVAQ Rx mini.
message.field: Ivaq Rx mini Status
Ivaq Rx mini SD Card State
Current acquisition/transfer state.

message.name: IVAQ_RX_MINI_SET_PARAMS
message.description: Host command to IVAQ Rx mini. Send at most one action per message: update, reset, or a nonzero capture command. The receiver must reject conflicting actions and unsupported or busy requests. Zero-valued fields request no action.
message.field: Request receiver firmware update mode.
Request receiver reset.
Requested acquisition/transfer action.

message.name: IVAQ_RX_MINI_SIGNAL
message.description: X/Y signal measurements from the two antennas on one IVAQ Rx mini PCB. Per-antenna detected values and timestamps are valid only when that antenna detection flag is set. Combined magnitude is valid only for X/Y measurements associated with the same pulse; otherwise send NaN. Noise measurements describe the current estimator window.
message.field: Detection mask: 0=none, 1=X, 2=Y, 3=both. Must agree with the per-antenna detection flags.
Detected pulse timestamp in the clock selected by rx_time_reference. For the overall event use the earliest valid antenna timestamp; zero if no detection.
Two-axis magnitude sqrt(X*X + Y*Y) from matched pulse amplitudes, using the corresponding corrected or uncorrected values; NaN if no matched pair.
Two-axis magnitude sqrt(X*X + Y*Y) from matched pulse amplitudes, using the corresponding corrected or uncorrected values; NaN if no matched pair.
